summary: Three changes stacked to take val_bpb from the 1.012347 baseline to 0.994308: halving TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 (2x optimizer steps, -0.011), replacing prepare.make_dataloader with a flat document-concatenation loader inside train.py (the stock best-fit packing costs ~209ms CPU per 128x2048 batch vs ~180ms of GPU work, so the baseline was dataloader-bound; -0.0044, MFU 28% -> 38%, 474M tokens), and DEPTH 8 -> 10 at fixed model_dim 512 (-0.0027). What did not work: quartering the batch to 2**17 (1.008119), DEPTH 12 (0.995232), and shortening the warmdown to 0.35 (0.996529). Next I would attack throughput again rather than hyperparameters -- the loader still burns ~109ms of CPU per batch and could be moved to a prefetch thread, and torch.compile mode=max-autotune is free because compilation happens outside the 300s budget -- then re-run the depth sweep at whatever token count that buys.
